displayDescription: A two-ink riso sheet on cool recycled stock: coral and blue separations print an idea that grows into a connected network.
styleRenderer: SVG (masks, patterns, clipPath, <use> ink clones, stroke-dashoffset, feTurbulence/feDisplacementMap static edge roughness, mix-blend-mode multiply)
motionEngine: Motion 14.1.0 (interpolate + easing; bundled locally to motion-kit.js with esbuild) for all visual property values
GSAP paused timeline as the single seekable clock (window.__timelines.video)
limitations: Ink grain, dropouts, overprint and edge roughness are procedural SVG/PNG approximations of risograph printing, not a physical print or scan.
The overprint uses CSS multiply blending, which approximates real ink transparency.
Typography uses locally installed system fonts (Arial Black or Helvetica fallback, Courier New), so glyph widths may vary slightly by machine; the headline is measured at runtime.
No tech.preview_recipes were supplied, so the preview demonstrates the primary style implementation together with the source-frame refresh lessons.
The coral headline layer is an aria-hidden SVG <use> clone of the blue type, so the misregistered second ink reads as print texture rather than as separate text.
